personality_one_liner: A sharp, high-contrast, professional B2B command center anchored in strict black-and-white, designed for absolute utility and operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and sections have md/lg gaps. Whitespace is used structurally to separate B2B KPI blocks.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Apply subtle glass on the 'Audit in progress' banner if it floats over scrolling content.
dont's: Never use glass on data/KPI cards.
Avoid heavy blurs that reduce the stark B2B contrast.

screens.name: Sign In
screens.purpose: A trustworthy, hyper-clean entry point for business owners.

states.error: Standard inline text validation (error text color) below inputs.

screens.layout: Centered PriceBuddy logo at top. Single-column form layout. Labels strictly above inputs (no floating). Inputs have border scale (1pt). Sticky brandPrimary (Black) CTA at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView. Minimalist, high-contrast, no distracting background imagery.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: The main B2B operational center summarizing contract health, upcoming renewals, and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for KPI cards and upcoming renewal.
states.empty: Clean illustration of an office desk (empty_desk image) with a short message 'No contracts uploaded yet' and a prominent 'Scan a bill' CTA.
states.error: Readable text block offering a retry.

screens.layout: Top section: 'Audit in progress' banner (surfaceSecondary with warning accent line or border). Below banner: Hero Metric (Utility Health Summary) using the utilityUrgency colors as status dots or colored metric counters. Next: 'Upcoming Renewal' featured card with a clear date and CTA. Bottom area: Grid of Quick Actions (Scan Bill, View Renewals) represented as tactile tiles with Phosphor icons.

screens.name: Bill Scanning
screens.purpose: Camera capture interface optimized for extracting document edges.

states.loading: OCR Processing State: A dark, translucent overlay covering the screen with a centered spinner and 'Extracting document details (this may take up to 60s)...'
states.empty: Camera feed searching for edges (subtle corner frames).
states.error: Retry modal if OCR fails or camera permission is denied.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view. A dark semi-transparent overlay (surfaceInverse at 70% opacity) masks the background, leaving a bright central rectangular 'scan frame'. Shutter button anchored inside a bottom container. Secondary 'Pick from Gallery' action placed next to the shutter. Once captured, a clear success toast or transition occurs before returning to dashboard.

empty_desk.alt: Clean modern office desk flatlay representing an empty state for document uploads

abstract_energy_bg.alt: Abstract clean background pattern for hero moments or banners

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the strict black-and-white theme with the requested iOS-Native Clean layout principles. The brand identity of PriceBuddy is heavily reliant on a stark #000000 primary canvas.
Implement the 'utilityUrgency' colors precisely for dashboard KPI counters, dots, or status pills. This is critical for B2B operational scanning.
Ensure the '/scan' screen has a camera-mask overlay (dark with a clear center cutout) to guide users framing the utility bill.
Implement an explicit OCR loading state for the scan screen that communicates a 30-60s wait time to avoid user frustration.
Ensure 'Scan a bill' and 'View renewals' are easily accessible on the dashboard through large, tactile hit targets.
Do NOT use blue tokens anywhere; rely on the provided utilityUrgency dictionary and slate/emerald accents.
Ensure sticky buttons use KeyboardAvoidingView correctly on the Sign In screen.
